somos.title: Who Are We?
somos.description: A family business dedicated to the production and export of vegetables, mainly cilantro, spring onion, zucchini, and broccoli of the highest quality, cultivated with passion and care in our fields. Our commitment to excellence, sustainability, and innovation has positioned us as a benchmark in the international market, reaching every corner. We guarantee an impeccable process, ensuring that each vegetable retains its freshness, color, and aroma, offering our customers a premium product that exceeds expectations. At Sons Farms, we bloom with every shipment.

conoce.title: Discover Our History
conoce.description: Founded in 2007 as an initiative of the government at that time, since Puebla’s production was exclusively for the national market. With this initiative, several producers united and, over the years, created different packaging facilities. This led to the creation of what we now know as Flores Farms, a family business that has evolved over time to meet international market standards.
conoce.description2: Since its inception, Flores Farms has worked with dedication and effort to offer the highest quality products, expanding its presence beyond national borders. Over the years, we have implemented cutting-edge technology in production processes, quality control systems, and sustainable farming methods, ensuring the freshness and excellence of our products. Our company has not only solidified itself in the export sector but has also fostered the development of the local agricultural community, creating jobs and providing growth opportunities for numerous families.

tar1.description: To be the leading company in the region in cilantro export, recognized for its quality and commitment to our customers. We focus on offering fresh and excellent products, meeting the highest international food safety and sustainability standards.

tar2.title: Innovation and Efficiency
tar2.description: We work with a focus on innovation, sustainable development, and environmental respect, implementing responsible agricultural practices that guarantee the freshness and safety of our products.

tar3.title: Responsibility and Sustainability
tar3.description: We are committed to strengthening our business relationships with customers and strategic partners, providing a reliable, efficient, and personalized service. Additionally, we aim to generate a positive impact in our community.
